guidance.bestFor: A query held in React state, with an X inside the input that appears once text is typed and empties it
agentNotes: `filteredItems` repeats the built in matching; set `filter` to null on `Autocomplete` before matching on fields other than `value`

whenNotToUse.when: A field that also needs a button to open the whole list

guidance.bestFor: A chevron button at the end of the input that opens the full list before anything is typed
agentNotes: Matching runs twice, in `filteredItems` and in the default filter, so pass `filter` as null when you replace the match logic

whenNotToUse.when: A field that also needs a button to empty the typed text

guidance.bestFor: Both end buttons at the default h-8 size in one spot: the chevron opens the list while empty, the X takes over once text is typed
agentNotes: The default filter still runs over `filteredItems`; null out `filter` first if your own matching reads other fields

whenNotToUse.when: Suggestions that come from a request with loading and error states

guidance.bestFor: A people directory of 26 users in 6 teams under sticky labels, matched on name, team or job title
agentNotes: Replace `usersData`, whose `avatar` URLs load from randomuser.me, with your own directory
`groupUsers` keeps only the teams listed in its `order` array, so users of any other team silently drop out
`filter` is null, so `filteredItems` alone decides matches over name, team and position; add any new field there

whenNotToUse.when: People found by a server query rather than a list loaded up front

guidance.bestFor: A debounced lookup of 25 developers with a spinner, error text and result count in a status line
agentNotes: Replace `searchDevelopers` with your request; it waits 200 to 1000ms at random and throws on 2% of calls or when the query is "error"
Keep the `ignore` flag when you swap in a real fetch, since it discards a response that lands after the query changed
`shouldRenderPopup` keeps the popup unmounted while `searchValue` is empty, so the chevron opens nothing before typing

whenNotToUse.when: Options known up front in the page, with no request, loading or error states

guidance.bestFor: The sm size at h-7 with the clear X and chevron, for dense filter bars and toolbars

whenNotToUse.when: A taller field for a prominent search bar

guidance.bestFor: The lg size at h-9, keeping the chevron and clear X, for a search bar that leads a page

whenNotToUse.when: A compact field that fits a crowded filter row

guidance.bestFor: A React Hook Form field checked by zod that rejects text matching no item, with the error shown on submit
agentNotes: `onSubmit` only raises a `toast` with `data.feature` and resets the form; save the value there and mount the Sonner toaster
`FormSchema` accepts only text equal to an `items` value; drop its `refine` to let users submit free text
